system.description:
You coat your hands and feet in a layer of compressed wind release chakra.

For the duration of this jutsu, when you take the attack action to make an unarmed attack, you can make a melee ninjutsu attack and your unarmed damage becomes 1d10 + ninjutsu ability modifier and deals wind damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, when you deal unarmed damage while this jutsu is active, you can force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 20 feet on a failed saving throw. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this jutsu’s range becomes 10 feet and can be applied to a willing creature in range. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d10.
